description: The Big Bar Ski Trail network offers approximately 26kms of cross country ski trails ranging in difficulty from beginner to advanced. Skiers will enjoy spectacular views of the Marble Range and 51 Creek Canyon.
directions: From Clinton, travel North on Hwy 97 to the Big Bar Lake turnoff. Turn onto Big Bar Lake road and follow the road for approximately 6kms to the main parking area.

stats.Activity Details: Viewing, Picnicking, Snowshoeing, Hiking, Ski Touring, Skiing
stats.Closure: The Big Bar Cross Country Ski Trails are closed due to an active wildfire in the area. The area is currently under Evacuation Order. Find further information at www.bcwildfire.ca
stats.Recreation District: Rec Dist - South Cariboo - Chilcotin - Central Coast

title: Big Bar Cross Country Ski Trails
